name: Golden 1 Credit Union
notes: Researched from public golden1.com and help.golden1.com pages only (no sign-in; golden1.com times out for scripted fetches, pages were read in a normal browser). The bill is a Golden 1 loan or credit card payment. Online/Mobile Banking: one-time and recurring payments from Golden 1 checking or an external account, no fee. Make One-Time Payment from another institution works without a password or login (account type, account info, payment option, bank account) and carries a usage fee whose amount is not published, so no guest fee is set; guest methods bank only (documented: bank account information). The public Set Up Recurring Payment page also describes paper authorization forms (mail or fax with a voided check) for automatic transfers from Golden 1 checking. Enrollment: Enroll in Personal Digital Banking with full account number, book number or debit card number, possibly full SSN, then a one-time passcode by text, phone call or email (enrollment MFA; login MFA is not documented, so the family default stays), then create a User ID and password. Loan due dates on closed-end loans (not mortgages) can be moved within the month to the 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th or 25th by phone; lines of credit are fixed on the 5th. Skip-A-Payment (up to two payments, eligible loans) and principal-only/lump-sum payments ($5,000+) are by phone or branch only. Member Service Contact Center 1-877-GOLDEN 1 (1-877-465-3361); the help article's alternative number 1-877-465-3391 appears to be a typo and is not used. Paperless: opt in to Online Statements and Notices with the I Agree consent; categories adjustable in delivery preferences.

public.label: Pay My Loan or Credit Card

pay_online.note: No fee to pay in Online or Mobile Banking.

guest_pay.note: Pay from another institution on Golden 1's website without a login.

autopay.note: Recurring payments in Online or Mobile Banking; paper authorization forms are also accepted.

payment_arrangement.note: Golden 1 has no online repayment plan. Skip-A-Payment, due-date changes and principal-only payments are handled by phone at 1-877-465-3361 or at a branch.

help.title: Pay my loan or credit card
paragraphs: Set up one-time or recurring payments for a car loan, personal loan, credit card, mortgage or home equity loan in Golden 1 Online Banking or the Mobile Banking app. There is no fee to pay in Online or Mobile Banking.
For a car loan, personal loan, credit card or home equity loan you can instead pay on Golden 1's website from another financial institution without logging in; that alternative carries a usage fee.

help.title: Make a one-time payment without logging in
paragraphs: To pay from another financial institution without creating a password or logging in, use Make One-Time Payment on Golden 1's website: select the account type, enter the account information, choose your payment option and provide your bank account information. The service runs around the clock.
steps: Enter the account information and payment option.
Provide your bank account information and submit.

help.title: Recurring payments
paragraphs: Set up recurring loan or credit card payments in Online Banking or the Mobile Banking app.

You can also authorize automatic transfers from your Golden 1 checking account on paper: complete and sign the authorization for automatic loan payments and mail it with a voided check to the Loan Service Center, or send the Visa credit card automatic payment form to Card Operations by mail or fax.

help.title: Change your loan due date
paragraphs: On closed-end loans other than mortgages you can move the due date within the same month to the 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th or 25th. Lines of credit are always due on the 5th. Call 1-877-465-3361 to make the change.
Skip-A-Payment may let you skip up to two payments on certain loans, and principal-only or lump-sum payments of $5,000 or more can re-amortize some loans. Both are handled by phone or at a branch.

help.title: Enroll in Online or Mobile Banking
paragraphs: Select Log In and choose Enroll in Personal Digital Banking. Enter your full account number, book number or debit card number (you may be asked for your full Social Security number), then confirm a one-time passcode sent by text, phone call or email. You may also be asked for a selfie or ID photo. Then create your User ID and password.

help.title: Online statements and notices
paragraphs: Opt in to online statements, disclosures and notices by checking I Agree on the consent. Opting in covers account, card and loan statements and other notices; to receive only some categories electronically, change your delivery preferences after logging in.

help.title: Other ways to pay a loan
paragraphs: In Online and Mobile Banking, payments can come from your Golden 1 checking or an external account at another institution. You can also call the Member Service Contact Center at 1-877-GOLDEN 1 (1-877-465-3361), Monday to Friday 7:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific, visit a branch, or mail a payment with a coupon (coupon books are for closed-end loans and can be requested by phone or at a branch).

extra.intent: Using Golden 1's help pages, list the days of the month a Golden 1 closed-end loan payment can be moved to. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Golden 1's help pages, find the minimum principal-only payment for a loan to be eligible for re-amortization. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
